items.body: The raid on the Roman Ghetto took place on 16 October 1943. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: American Revolutionary War: The British-led Royalton raid is the last Native American raid on New England.
items.body: The Royalton raid was a British-led Indian raid in 1780 against various towns along the White River Valley in the Vermont Republic during the American Revolutionary War. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Nuremberg trials: Ten defendants found guilty by the International Military Tribunal are executed by hanging.
items.body: The Nuremberg trials were international criminal trials held by France, the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States against leaders of defeated Nazi Germany for plotting and carrying out invasions of several countries across Europe and committing atrocities against their citizens in the Second World War. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Débora is an experimental novella by Ecuadorian writer Pablo Palacio, published in Quito in October 1927.
items.body: In 2007, the novella was included in a compilation of the author's complete works by publishing house Libresa. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Ricimer defeats Avitus at Piacenza and becomes master of the Western Roman Empire.
items.body: Ricimer was a Romanized Germanic general, who ruled the remaining territory of the Western Roman Empire from 456 after defeating Avitus, until his death in 472, with a brief interlude in which he contested power with Procopius Anthemius. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: As I Lay Dying is a 1930 Southern Gothic novel by American author William Faulkner.
items.body: Faulkner's fifth novel, it is consistently ranked among the best novels of the 20th century. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Abd ar-Rahman III becomes the eighth Emir of Córdoba.
items.body: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥakam ibn Hishām ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Marwānī al-Umawī al-Qurashī, or simply ʿAbd al-Raḥmān III, was the eighth and final Emir of Córdoba from 912 to 929. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.
